coverageNote.note: Crowley operates roughly 270 terminals and ports across the Americas. 26 were audited and 8 are verified as Crowley-operated yards with dated independent sourcing. 3 were rejected because an independent terminal operator runs them and Crowley is only a port of call: Penn Terminals (PSA), Gloucester (Holt Logistics), and Wilmington (NC State Ports Authority). The remaining 15 are audited but not yet verified, so they are held back rather than shown.

account.dossierIntro: Crowley runs marine terminals, port logistics, and container distribution across the Americas. We verified 8 Crowley-operated terminals and yards, each confirmed against Crowley's own locations record and independent terminal sources. Talleyrand covers 197 acres in Jacksonville and holds 1,400 trailer and chassis spots. The Jacksonville cross dock runs 58 dock doors and CrowleyFresh runs 52. 4 of the 8 are rail-served. Across the 8 verified sites: 4,435 trailer and chassis spots, 152 dock doors, 662 acres. Ports of call that another company operates are excluded, so every yard shown here is one Crowley actually runs.
surprisingFindings: 4,435 trailer and chassis spots are the RTLS pricing driver. They are a different unit from the container ground slots stacked at the terminals.
Talleyrand is 197 acres of port operations. Crowley dominates Jacksonville's logistics footprint.
4 of the 8 verified sites are rail-served. Port logistics runs on intermodal.
